features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized glucose and BMI, providing a non-linear feature for the linear model.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to capture the synergistic effect of high glucose and high BMI.

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Age standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves convergence and margin calculation in linear SVM by putting age on a similar scale to other features.

features.name: glucose_normalized
features.description: Glucose standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures glucose variance does not dominate the SVM objective function.

features.name: bmi_normalized
features.description: BMI standardized using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes BMI for balanced margin penalization.

features.name: pedigree_log
features.description: Log-transformed diabetes pedigree function to reduce right-skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes the distribution of the pedigree function more symmetric, which is favorable for linear models.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Ratio of insulin to glucose, capturing the relative insulin response.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a physiological ratio that might be linearly separable from other states.

features.name: metabolic_risk_score
features.description: A linear composite score summing normalized glucose, BMI, and age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-computes a linear combination of known risk factors, providing a strong single feature for the SVM.

features.name: pregnancies_per_year
features.description: Number of pregnancies divided by estimated reproductive years (age - 12).
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes pregnancy count by age, creating a more comparable rate feature across different ages.

features.name: blood_pressure_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of blood pressure from the training set mean, scaled by standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures abnormality in blood pressure (both high and low) as a single continuous severity measure.

features.name: is_missing_insulin_skin
features.description: Indicator variable for rows where both insulin and skin thickness are zero (likely missing data).
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to apply a specific bias offset for records with this pattern of missing data.

features.name: clinical_severity_assessment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall clinical severity based on the combination of glucose, BMI, blood pressure, and age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-linear clinical heuristics that a linear SVM cannot easily deduce from raw features.

features.name: lifestyle_intervention_priority
features.description: Semantic judgment of how urgently lifestyle intervention is needed, evaluating BMI, blood pressure, and glucose levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal severity scale that aligns well with linear margin separation.
